units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 65b:5">B. Kam. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ ד׳ וחומשא זוזא</he> the thief’s fine amounts to four Zuz and the one-fifth-fine (v. <cite ref="H00398"><he>חוּמְשָׁא</he></cite>) to one Zuz; a. e.

<cite ref="Nedarim 48b:7">Ned. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>לאתויי מילתא דשדיא בכ׳</he> Ar. (marg. vers. <cite ref="K01014"><he>כפילה</he></cite>) to include that case (mentioned before) which was decided on the basis of a twofold eventuality (either the son or the grandson becoming a scholar); [ed. <he>הא … דשדיא בכיפי</he> that case which came up in consequence of the son’s roaming about (stealing) sheaves of flax].
